name: "Docs + Plans"
description: "Write clear plans and keep terminology consistent"
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,README.md,CLAUDE.md,AGENTS.md,notes/**/*.md,.github/**/*.md"

# Documentation rules
- Use consistent vocabulary: Space, Edge, Payload, Annotation, OperatorRun, GraphPatch, Manifest.
- Plans must include: goals/non-goals, files to touch, steps, tradeoffs, TODO checklist.
- Prefer concrete steps over prose; write for future-you doing code review.
